issuing_body: U.S. District Court, District of Minnesota; publicly hosted by U.S. Department of Justice
title: United States v. Qamar Ahmed Hassan et al. — Indictment, ECF No. 1
notes: Original ECF No. 1 indictment. The official DOJ-hosted PDF is unusually large and was not committed as a binary in this pass; the DOJ attachment remains the canonical host. Search-indexed text from the official attachment identifies the filing as Doc. 1 filed 2022-09-13 and reproduces the Count 1 statute language.
supports: Count 1 charges conspiracy to commit wire fraud in violation of 18 U.S.C. §§ 371 and 1343.
The original indictment does not use 18 U.S.C. § 1349 for Count 1; the charged wire-fraud conspiracy is the general conspiracy statute, § 371, with § 1343 as the object offense.
The indictment is the original charging instrument in case 0:22-cr-00224, not a later superseding indictment.
does_not_support: A network-wide conclusion that no Feeding Our Future charging instrument ever used § 1349; this source is specific to 22-CR-224.
Adjudicated guilt; these are charging allegations.
